content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"LPD Flight II is a U.S. Navy program that funds construction of amphibious transport dock ships, a class of vessel used to carry Marines, their equipment, and landing craft for amphibious operations.","citation":{"fact_id":"3f9a467c9e4a73f6"}},{"text":"The program is categorized as shipbuilding and is funded through the Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy account.","citation":{"fact_id":"3f9a467c9e4a73f6"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"In fiscal year 2024, the program recorded actual spending of $500,000 thousand (about $500 million).","citation":{"fact_id":"3f9a467c9e4a73f6"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2026, the program's requested total rises to $2,600,000 thousand (about $2.6 billion), more than five times the 2024 actual level — a substantial increase reflecting the high cost of building large amphibious ships.","citation":{"fact_id":"e0361573b0ce7727"}}]},"players":{"claims":[]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
